headword: {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}
gloss: demonstration experiment; proof-of-concept test; field trial

definitions.gloss: demonstration experiment; proof-of-concept test; field trial
definitions.explanation: A practical experiment conducted to verify the feasibility or effectiveness of a new technology, system, or method in real-world conditions.

examples.japanese: {自動運転|じどううんてん}の{実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: A field trial for autonomous driving has begun.

examples.japanese: {市|し}は{新|あたら}しい{交通|こうつう}システムの{実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: The city is conducting a proof-of-concept test for a new transportation system.

examples.japanese: {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}の{結果|けっか}を{踏|ふ}まえて、{来年|らいねん}から{本格的|ほんかくてき}に{導入|どうにゅう}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: Based on the results of the field trial, full-scale implementation is planned for next year.

notes:
Composed of {実証|じっしょう} (demonstration, empirical proof) + {実験|じっけん} (experiment). A widely used term in news and business for testing new technologies, services, and systems before full-scale deployment. Common in transportation, energy, agriculture, and IT contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}を{行|おこな}う — conduct a field trial
- {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}を{開始|かいし}する — start a demonstration experiment
- {実証実験|じっしょうじっけん}の{結果|けっか} — results of the trial
- {大規模|だいきぼ}{実証実験|じっしょうじっけん} — large-scale field trial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実験|じっけん} — experiment; more general, including laboratory experiments
- {試験|しけん} — test, trial; broader term that also covers exams and product testing
- パイロット{事業|じぎょう} — pilot project; similar concept but emphasizes the business/project aspect rather than the experimental verification
